items.question: Which East Java destinations does JVTO cover?
items.answer: Five sites on the private East Java circuit: Kawah Ijen (active acidic crater lake, blue-fire night hike), Mount Bromo (Tengger caldera sunrise), Tumpak Sewu (multi-tiered waterfall), Madakaripura (Java's tallest waterfall), and Papuma Beach (coastal headland). Each is reached by dedicated private vehicle.

items.question: How do I get between the destinations?
items.answer: Every destination is reached by dedicated private vehicle — an AC MPV for smaller groups (2–3 guests) or a Toyota Hiace for larger groups (4–9). No public buses and no shared transfers. BBKSDA park clearance is arranged in advance.

items.question: Will I definitely see the blue fire at Ijen?
items.answer: The blue fire is a natural phenomenon — sulfuric gases igniting at the crater floor — visible in suitable weather. It is subject to weather and gas activity and can never be guaranteed. JVTO plans the pre-dawn viewing window around the best conditions, but does not promise an outcome that depends on volcanic gas activity.
